rationale: The source toggle is transferred through two destination-clock flops, so the unrelated source and destination clocks are correctly asynchronous while each external pulse interface has a delay in its owning domain.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the pulse synchronizer to a source toggle, a two-flop destination synchronizer, and edge reconstruction.

mutation.description: The destination pulse is formed from the two synchronizer stages; no combinational source-to-destination data path is timing-constrained as synchronous.
